name: spotify-show-cover
description: Podcast show cover for Spotify (and every directory that reads the same RSS feed): 3000x3000, 1:1, RGB, no transparency. One bold mark and the show name, large, on a simple high-contrast field; no tagline, episode numbers or URLs. Brand-neutral placeholder: swap the mark for the project's supplied logo (image layer, fit contain) and the colours and font for the brand inputs. Export JPG (quality 90) or PNG.
